company.title: Renewable Vietnam
company.description: Renewable Vietnam is an independent, non-commercial information hub for Viet Nam's clean energy transition. It gathers progress, projects and outlook on solar, wind and hydropower in one plain-language place, alongside an interactive map of renewable potential across the country.
company.history: Renewable Vietnam started as a single interactive map of solar, wind and hydro potential across Viet Nam. It has since grown into a small publication, with background on where the country's electricity comes from and how the shift toward renewables is progressing toward 2030.
